base.alt: Concept image: a bright, empty dining room with dated walls and a bare floor, before any design work.

baseVariants.prompt: A realistic photograph of an EMPTY dining room in an ordinary 1990s to 2010s Midwest American suburban house, not a loft and not luxury. Bright, open and airy: big windows, lots of soft daylight, light floors. A tall ceiling with a single electrical box in the middle and no fixture. Plain thin builder baseboards, no crown moulding. Eye-level camera standing in a corner. One large, plain, completely clear main wall is fully visible and unobstructed. Nothing hangs on the walls. No people, no plants, no text, no logos. Natural colour, gentle shadows, 4:3 photograph. The walls are painted a dull, dated grey lavender that looks a little dreary.

stages.caption: A dining room starts with its architecture: crown moulding, tall baseboards and a chair rail.
A fan-patterned rug and a round table, so everyone can see everyone.
Curved velvet chairs, deep green against all that black and brass.
One statement light, hung low enough to make the table feel like the centre of the room.
A fluted sideboard for the good dishes, and a sunburst mirror to bounce the light around.
Candlesticks and flowers, set for dinner.

final.alt: Concept image: the finished dining room in an art deco style, with a round black table, emerald velvet chairs, a brass chandelier, a fluted sideboard and a sunburst mirror.
